description: Fork of exp104 (Tiny sparse_scatter) replacing only qk_joint with MultiHeadLut(smooth_mode=True, n_alternatives=3) + external SparseScatter. v_lut and out_proj remain TinyMultiHeadLut. Goal: isolate whether the smooth-mode benefit observed in exp100 vs exp104 (-0.046 bpb) primarily comes from qk_joint, or whether it's distributed across all 3 modules. Same architecture otherwise: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, all 3 LUTs at nap=8/n_sparse=8, qk/v tph=384, out tph=2048.
